messages:
maya: FYI customer on Dedicated reported streaming cut off after ~30s of silence. They see partial tokens then a reconnect from client.
ben: Which load balancer in front of us? ALB or Cloudflare?
maya: ALB in front of Envoy, Cloudflare in front of that for the region. customer says it only happens when user pauses typing for ~20-45s.
anya: Sounds like idle-probe + proxy coalescing. Do we have tcp_keepalive configured on the edge?
sam: Our nginx Envoy path sets keepalive 60s, but ALB idle timeout is 30s for that customer (default). Could be ALB closes and Cloudflare retries.
maya: Logs from customer: `event: data chunk
bytes: 512
status: 200` then silent, then client recvs FIN.
maya: Attaching their pcap snippet (redacted) — they see ALB FIN-to-client w/ no final chunk.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2117. Linking ticket #4821.
ben: Could auth token rotation be involved? When client reconnects it might re-auth with a stale cookie and gateway returns 401 mid-stream, client drops.
anya: Check our token-refresh logs for that session id: `sess-8a3f`.
anya: I see a token refresh at 1788001250 and a failed replay attempt from CF at 1788001278 -> 401.
maya: Customer also reported duplicate billing spike when client reconnected. They get 2 sessions billed for same request.
sam: That's probably because the retry path forks: client reconnects, server spins a new generator instance while the old generator kept running until ALB closed. We should tie-run IDs to prevent double-billing on reconnect within X seconds.
ben: Repro plan: 1) set ALB idle timeout to 65s 2) simulate auth rotation mid-idle 3) capture tcpdump at edge and origin 4) verify streaming boundary (last-chunk) is emitted before FIN.
maya: Can someone try with Cloudflare Worker + ALB in front of Envoy? I can repro in staging if you give me a script.
anya: Quick repro script (curl):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://staging.redwood/api/v1/stream?model=redwood-small" --limit-rate 1k
# Pause stdin for 35s -> resume
```
anya: Expected: server keeps SSE stream open and sends heartbeat chunks. Observed: ALB half-closes, CF rewrites, client reauth fails.
sam: Workaround for customer: increase ALB idle timeout and enable explicit SSE heartbeats from app (every 15s). Also advise sticky tokens / extend token grace on reconnect.
maya: Customer asked for a patch timeline — any chance we can add a short-term server-side mitigation (detect duplicate live runs and cancel older run on reconnect)?
ben: We can add a conservative dedupe: if reconnect with same user+request hash within 60s, drop previous run and mark it non-billable. Need PR + DB flag.
anya: I'll open a cleanup task and draft the exception logic. Will ping when PR is ready for review.
maya: Thanks. I'll share repro steps + pcap in ticket. Customer appreciates workaround while we patch. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INC-2026-2117 status -> triaged. Assigned to anya.
